Implement the requested feature.

1. Inspect relevant code and tests.
2. Identify ownership and contracts.
3. Plan the smallest complete slice.
4. Implement backend/frontend/persistence changes as required.
5. Keep frontend -> gateway -> service contracts aligned.
6. Preserve database ownership.
7. Add/update tests.
8. Run relevant validation.
9. Review the diff.

Return files changed, validation performed, and remaining limitations.
